newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 22.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 22.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* U.S. Dow Jones industrial average ended down 13 points to 7,290.69 on Wednesday.
* Dealers return to their desks after one-day public holiday. First trading day after U.S. Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged on Tuesday.
* Philippines, Thai and Indonesian markets rallied on Wednesday on the news.
* Malaysia's blue-chip Composite Index closed 17.23 points higher to 1,058.62 on Tuesday on local funds support.

* PSC Industries Bhd's subsidiary Penang Shipbuilding and Construction Sdn Bhd said on Tuesday it had entered into an agreement to develop ports and rail facilities in Mozambique for around $950 million.
